identifiedBy.fact: Approach as for the East Route to Lyman Lake (sibling East Route starts at Holden Village / Railroad Creek)

identifiedBy.fact: Mountaineers climb of Easy Mox (NW Mox) started at Depot Creek TH, via Lake Ouzel and Glacier Col; route's own text calls the NE ridge the standard route on this spire

identifiedBy.fact: Cascade River Road, final 3 miles to the trailhead; same approach infrastructure as the Southwest Route

otherFacts.value: Cascade River Road closed at MP 20 for maintenance (notice 10.15.26)

notes: Route text never names the trailhead; Cascade Pass is inferred from the road description (road ends there, 23 mi from Marblemount). Only one placement (WTA); not in the official list. No page found linking Old Guard explicitly to Cascade Pass; low confidence.
